title: Grand Theft Auto VI is a different kind of GTA — so it needed a different kind of ending
summary: In most Grand Theft Auto games, and most open-world games for that matter, the world is left open for you to explore once the credits roll. It could be Los Santos or a twisted take on Manhattan, but the idea is that the main story is just one part of the experience. After that's done, […]
content: In most Grand Theft Auto games, and most open-world games for that matter, the world is left open for you to explore once the credits roll. It could be Los Santos or a twisted take on Manhattan , but the idea is that the main story is just one part of the experience. After that's done, there are usually still places you haven't explored or side missions you left lingering. But Grand Theft Auto VI doesn't work quite the same way. Because of its storyline, which involves a couple trying to get out of the criminal life for good, that kind of ending didn't really fit. "In this one it didn't make sense," Rob Nelson, producer on GTA VI and co-stud … Read the full story at The Verge.

content: This year’s Black Friday deals have launched in waves over the past several weeks, but now the floodgates have officially opened. You can now take advantage of the lowest prices we’ve seen in-store and online for video games, wireless earbuds, TVs, e-readers, robot vacuums, and so much more. We can’t guarantee a deal you’ve had your eye on will last through Cyber Monday; however, if prior years are any indication, most will stick around through the long holiday weekend. As usual, we sorted through thousands of deals to find the ones truly worth sharing, with an eye for the products and services we’ve tested here at The Verge . With prices up across multiple categories due to RAMageddon, some deals may not seem as big as in prior years. For example, Apple’s latest MacBook Air recently fell to its pre-price hike level for the first time since July. That’s a deal to us, and several other discounts are taking a similar shape. We’ll provide context when possible and keep this post updated throughout the day. AirPods Pro 3 Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 deliver the best noise cancellation and sound quality of any AirPods yet, along with a more comfortable, secure fit and improved water resistance. title: Our favorite headphones and earbuds are cheaper than ever for Black Friday
summary: If you haven’t already caved and bought a fresh set of wireless earbuds, over-ear headphones, or bone conduction headphones this year, Black Friday is rewarding you with a colossal amount of deals, including discounts on the best models available. content: The stylish Beats 360 are $100 off their original price this week. | Photo: Amelia Holowaty Krales / The Verge If you haven’t already caved and bought a fresh set of wireless earbuds, over-ear headphones, or bone conduction headphones this year, Black Friday is rewarding you with a colossal amount of deals, including discounts on the best models available. Apple, Beats, Soundcore, Sony, Nothing, and other major brands are offering some of the best prices we’ve seen on many of their products, whether you’re on a tight sub-$100 budget or willing to spend more (but still want a great deal). We’re seeing some surprisingly great sale prices, especially on noise-canceling earbuds like the AirPods Pro 3 and Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro . Bose QuietComfort Headphones Gen 2 Bose’s second-gen QuietComfort Headphones build on the original with better sound quality and support for lossless audio over USB-C. They also offer improved noise cancellation and are more comfortable thanks to their lack of “eardrum suck.” Where to Buy: $359 $199 at Amazon $359 $199 at Best Buy $359 $219 at Bose Shokz OpenRun The standard OpenRun are a lighter option than the newer OpenRun Pro 2, with a streamlined wraparound design, up to eight hours of battery life, and an IP67 rating for better water resistance. However, they don’t offer the same bass performance or USB-C charging. Where to Buy: $149.95 $89.94 at Amazon $149.95 $89.99 at Best Buy Beats Studio Pro The latest Beats Studio Pro feature improved noise cancellation, sound quality, and comfort. They also support lossless audio over USB-C and offer native support for a range of iOS and Android features like other Beats headphones. Read our review . The over-ear headphones boast fantastic sound and a few useful features that first-time buyers will likely love. But first-gen owners aren’t missing out on much. Read our review . Where to Buy: $549 $419 at Amazon $549 $419 at Best Buy Soundcore Liberty 5 Pro The Liberty 5 Pro are Soundcore’s most impressive wireless earbuds yet. At this price, they’re a steal, thanks to their superb call quality and a slew of other features typically reserved for higher-end models. Read our review . The 1 Pro are comfortable, with great sound from its triple-driver design, and they support Auracast. Their ANC isn’t quite at the level of pricier competitors, but they’re a solid value at the Black Friday price. Read our review . title: The SE 3 is the Apple Watch most people should buy on Black Friday
summary: During Black Friday, the Apple Watch SE 3 is on sale in the 40mm / GPS configuration at Amazon, Walmart, and Target starting around $179 ($70 off), $20 less than its previous lowest price. The 44mm variant, meanwhile, is on sale at Amazon, Walmart, and Target starting at around $209 (also $70 off), also beating […]
content: The SE 3 adds an always-on display to Apple’s budget-friendly wearable. | Photo: Amelia Holowaty Krales / The Verge During Black Friday, the Apple Watch SE 3 is on sale in the 40mm / GPS configuration at Amazon , Walmart , and Target starting around $179 ($70 off), $20 less than its previous lowest price. The 44mm variant, meanwhile, is on sale at Amazon , Walmart , and Target starting at around $209 (also $70 off), also beating its previous low by $20. Apple Watch SE 3 Where to Buy: $249 $179 at Amazon (40mm, GPS) $249 $179 at Walmart (40mm, GPS) $279 $209 at Amazon (44mm, GPS) Despite having launched over a year ago, the Apple Watch SE 3 is still the Apple Watch model we recommend for most people. It includes many of the trademark features of higher-end Apple Watch models like the Series 12, including an always-on display, double-tap and wrist flick gestures, fast-charging, and on-device Siri. The compromise is that the SE 3 lacks some of the more advanced health features found on more expensive models, like blood oxygen and EKG sensing. The battery life also isn’t quite as strong, but if you don’t need as many health-tracking sensors, it’s a much better value, especially at this price. Read our Apple Watch SE 3 review .

title: The Oura Ring 5 just got its biggest discount ever for Black Friday
summary: If you’ve been curious about smart rings but have been put off by their high price tags, Black Friday is a good time to consider giving one a try. That’s because the Oura Ring 5, which we consider the best smart ring you can buy, has dropped to an all-time low of $299 ($100 off) […]
content: The Oura Ring 5 is smaller and more comfortable to wear than the Ring 4 (surprise, surprise). | Photo: Amelia Holowaty Krales / The Verge If you’ve been curious about smart rings but have been put off by their high price tags, Black Friday is a good time to consider giving one a try. That’s because the Oura Ring 5 , which we consider the best smart ring you can buy, has dropped to an all-time low of $299 ($100 off) at Amazon , Best Buy , Walmart , and Oura’s online storefront for Black Friday. Oura Ring 5 Where to Buy: $399 $299 at Amazon $399 $299 at Walmart $399 $299 at Best Buy Compared to the Ring 4 , the Oura Ring 5 offers a thinner, lighter, and more durable design that’s more comfortable to wear throughout the day and while sleeping. Like its predecessor, it can track your sleep, activity, heart rate, and other health metrics, giving you insights into your overall well-being without requiring you to constantly check a screen. It also offers roughly the same battery life and sensors as the prior model, though its new charging case supports wireless charging. (Unfortunately, the case is currently sold separately for $99 .) Oura has also introduced several new software features, including Health Radar, which looks for potentially significant changes in your health. You can also import medical lab results, track GLP-1 medications, and access AI-assisted medical guidance through Oura’s partnership with Counsel Health. My colleague Victoria Song appreciated how the latter makes it easier to connect with an actual doctor, though she found it better suited for quick medical questions than more serious health concerns. However, none of these software features are exclusive to the Ring 5, and you’ll still need a $5.99 monthly Oura membership to access most of its health insights. Given how similar the two generations are, we wouldn’t recommend upgrading if you already own a Ring 4. But if you’re new to smart rings, the current discount makes Oura’s latest model much more attractive, especially since it’s only $50 more than the Ring 4’s starting price. Read our full Oura Ring 5 review .

title: Buying a laptop right now is rough, but these Black Friday deals help

content: Affordable laptops are even more affordable right now. | Photo: Antonio G. Di Benedetto / The Verge Laptop prices have been a hot-button topic all year long thanks to RAMageddon . We’ve seen existing models get more expensive and new models arrive at higher prices than last-gen — sometimes with lower specs, too. 2026 in general has been a bad time to buy a computer. But thankfully, Black Friday can offer a tiny bit of respite. If the computer you currently use is working well for you, good. Happy for you. But if you’re in the market for something more powerful, bigger, smaller, thinner, etc. — and you prefer new over used — you can currently save some decent dough on MacBooks, Windows notebooks, and gaming laptops. The big, multi-hundred-dollar savings are typically reserved for higher-end models with bigger specs, like Windows models running Nvidia’s new Arm-based RTX Spark platform — which are getting their first major discounts. More budget-friendly laptops are also receiving decent discounts right now, though, including the MacBook Neo. The current $100 discount on Apple’s budget laptop might seem like small potatoes considering it’s just a return to its original price , but it’s the best you can do for now (if you can’t hold out for a rumored new one in 2027 ). As always, the deals below are for laptops we’ve reviewed or tested firsthand in some way at The Verge — either that exact model or a similar one we expect to be equally good. There are many laptops out there and myriad deals running now through Cyber Monday, but if any of these fit your needs, you can’t go wrong. MacBook Neo Apple’s most affordable laptop uses the same A18 Pro chip found in the iPhone 16 Pro. It features a vibrant 13-inch display, surprisingly good speakers, and 8GB of RAM, making it a solid option for students and anyone who needs a laptop for everyday tasks. Read our review . title: Some of our favorite Sony, LG, and TCL TVs are over 50 percent off for Black Friday
summary: Most of us spend a lot of time with our TVs, be it watching movies, TV shows, the news, or playing games. It’s part of being a fan of technology. And while they’re big purchases, they can last for years. But eventually, the time comes when we need a new one. Has that time come […]
content: The X11L is the best TV TCL has ever built, which is probably why it still starts at nearly $3,000. | Photo: John Higgins / The Verge Most of us spend a lot of time with our TVs, be it watching movies, TV shows, the news, or playing games. It’s part of being a fan of technology. And while they’re big purchases, they can last for years. But eventually, the time comes when we need a new one. Has that time come for you? Black Friday sales will make it easier to find something great for a lot less than it’d usually cost. With several different types of TVs out there, it can get confusing which ones are worth it. Are the new RGB LED TVs all they’re cracked up to be? (Sometimes.) Does OLED still deliver the best contrast available? (Yup.) Are tried-and-true LED TVs still worth it in 2026 for those on a budget? (Absolutely.) One thing you can be sure of, is any TV I recommend here is more than worth the price. If you need a TV, Black Friday is the time to buy. TCL X11L SQD-Mini LED TV TCL came out swinging early this year with its flagship X11L. It gets blazingly bright, has great color accuracy, and is now thousands of dollars cheaper than its original price. Read our review . Where to Buy: $6999.99 $2997.99 at Amazon (75-inch) $7999.99 $4999.99 at Best Buy (85-inch) $9999.99 $6997.99 at Amazon (98-inch) Vizio Mini LED Quantum 4K TV After a prolonged period of quiet, Vizio is back with a good Mini LED TV at a great price. The Quantum 4K offers solid brightness and contrast thanks to its small but mighty backlighting; however, its best feature is that it’s easy to make dumb and keep your viewing data private. Where to Buy: $248 $198 at Walmart (50-inch) $278 $248 at Walmart (55-inch) $398 $358 at Walmart (65-inch) LG B6E OLED TV Despite being an entry-level variant of the B6 OLED, this model features four HDMI 2.1 ports, a 120Hz refresh rate, a capable processor, and pixel-perfect image quality and contrast for any content you want to watch. Lower brightness is likely the biggest compromise with getting a cheaper OLED. Where to Buy: $1399.99 $699.99 at Best Buy (55-inch) $1899.99 $999.99 at Best Buy (65-inch) $2699.99 $1499.99 at Best Buy (77-inch) TCL QM8L The QM8L uses the same SQD technology as the X11L, which provides higher brightness and more colors, but at a fraction of the cost. Where to Buy: $2499.99 $997.99 at Amazon (65-inch) $2999.99 $1397.99 at Amazon (75-inch) $3999.99 $2297.99 at Amazon (85-inch) Sony Bravia 7 II RGB LED TV The Bravia 7 II is Sony’s first RGB LED TV. Its screen is a little reflective, but the picture is absolutely beautiful thanks to the color capability of the RGB LED backlight and Sony’s stellar processing. Read our review . Where to Buy: $2099.99 $1199.99 at Best Buy (55-inch) $2599.99 $1499.99 at Best Buy (65-inch) $3099.99 $1999.99 at Best Buy (75-inch) Hisense CanvasTV (2026) Hisense’s 2026 CanvasTV is a 4K QLED TV that doubles as wall art when you’re not watching. It features a matte, anti-glare display and runs on Google’s excellent TV software; it’s also a great pick for gamers thanks to its snappy 144Hz variable refresh rate and a pair of HDMI 2.1 ports. content: Widgets, your way. | Photo: Allison Johnson / The Verge Aside from dealing with my calendar , there's one thing I want AI to do: tell me if I'm about to miss the bus.
